source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־עָשָׂ֧ה הַיָּשָׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּדָוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of twenty year[s] [was] Ahaz when he became king, and sixteen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and not he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh like David his father.

en.L: Ahaz [was] twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not do the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, like David his father.
en.B: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as his ancestor David had done.
en.R: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. He did not do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, as his ancestor David had done.

es.L: Acaz [tenía] veinte años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén. Y no hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como David su padre.
es.B: Acaz tenía veinte años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén. No hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.
es.R: Acaz tenía veinte años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante dieciséis años. No hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.

fr.L: Achaz [avait] vingt ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Et il ne fit pas ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme David son père.
fr.B: Achaz avait vingt ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Il ne fit pas ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme l’avait fait son ancêtre David.
fr.R: Achaz avait vingt ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant seize ans. Il n’a pas fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, comme l’avait fait son ancêtre David.

sw.L: Ahazi [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye alitawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu. Wala hakufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Daudi baba yake.
sw.B: Ahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu. Hakufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.
sw.R: Ahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na sita. Hakufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.

vi.L: A-cha [được] hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua không làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như Đa-vít tổ phụ vua.
vi.B: A-cha được hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua không làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.
vi.R: A-cha được hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua, và vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười sáu năm. Vua không làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, như Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.

ko.L: 아하스가 왕이 되었을 때 20세였고, 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그는 그의 조상 다윗처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 하지 않았다.
ko.B: 아하스는 20세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 달리 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 아하스는 20세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 달리, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 하지 않았다.

pt.L: Acaz [tinha] vinte anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. E não fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como Davi, seu pai.
pt.B: Acaz tinha vinte anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. Ele não fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como o seu antepassado Davi tinha feito.
pt.R: Acaz tinha vinte anos quando se tornou rei, e governou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. Ele não fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, como o seu antepassado Davi tinha feito.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 16:2, with one difference
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats 2 Kings 16:2 almost word for word. Kings says "Yahweh his God"; Chronicles has only "Yahweh". As elsewhere, Chronicles leaves out the opening date by the reign of the king of Israel (2 Kings 16:1), and it names no mother for Ahaz, as Kings names none.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty years: twenty years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years. The numbers are hard to fit with the age of his son Hezekiah (29:1); see the note at 2 Kings 16:2.

decisions.choice: he did not do what was right ... like David: the good verdict denied
decisions.reason: The verdict given to the good kings is here turned into a denial. His father Jotham had received it (27:2). "David his father" means his ancestor David, the measure for every king of Judah.

decisions.choice: did not do the right in [the] eyes of / did not do what was right in the sight of / did not do what the LORD said was right; his ancestor
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 16:2 is kept at each level. Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" for "father", as they do wherever David is called the father of a later king.

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 16:2
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Spanish of 2 Kings 16:2; Chronicles has no "his God", so it is left out (m1).

decisions.choice: the wording of French 2 Kings 16:2, without "son Dieu"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the same Hebrew without "his God", so French drops only those words.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 16:2-4
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 keep the Swahili of 2 Kings 16:2-4 at each level, without "Mungu wake", which Chronicles leaves out.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 16:2 without "Đức Chúa Trời của ông"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the same words as 2 Kings 16:2 but does not add "his God" (m1), so the Vietnamese drops it too.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 16:2 without "그의 하나님", with figures for the age and years
alternatives: "이십 세", "스무 살", as the 2 Kings 16 draft has
decisions.reason: Chronicles has only "Yahweh" where Kings has "Yahweh his God" (m1); this block writes ages and years in figures.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 16:2, without "o seu Deus"
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2 Kings 16:2 (m1), and so does the Portuguese at each level: "Acaz [tinha] vinte anos" (L), the denied verdict, "seu pai" (L) and "o seu antepassado Davi" (B, R). Chronicles has only the divine name where Kings has "the LORD his God", so ", o seu Deus" is left out.

source.text: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֧ם מַסֵּכ֛וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה לַבְּעָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he walked in [the] ways of [the] kings of Israel, and also cast images he made for the Baals.

en.L: And he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and he even made cast images for the Baals.
en.B: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel; he also made images of cast metal for the Baals.
en.R: He lived the way the kings of Israel had lived. He even made metal idols for the Baals.

es.L: Y anduvo en los caminos de los reyes de Israel, y aun hizo imágenes de fundición para los baales.
es.B: Anduvo en los caminos de los reyes de Israel, e incluso hizo imágenes de metal fundido para los baales.
es.R: Vivió como habían vivido los reyes de Israel. Hasta hizo ídolos de metal para los baales.

fr.L: Et il marcha dans les voies des rois d’Israël, et même il fit des images de métal fondu pour les Baals.
fr.B: Il marcha dans les voies des rois d’Israël ; il fit aussi des statues de métal fondu pour les Baals.
fr.R: Il a vécu comme les rois d’Israël avaient vécu. Il a même fabriqué des idoles en métal pour les Baals.

sw.L: Naye akaenda katika njia za wafalme wa Israeli, tena akayafanyia Mabaali sanamu za kusubu.
sw.B: Alifuata njia za wafalme wa Israeli; pia akayatengenezea Mabaali sanamu za chuma cha kuyeyusha.
sw.R: Aliishi kama wafalme wa Israeli walivyoishi. Hata aliyatengenezea Mabaali sanamu za chuma.

vi.L: Vua đi trong các đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, và còn làm các tượng đúc cho các thần Ba-anh.
vi.B: Vua đi theo đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên; vua cũng làm các tượng đúc bằng kim loại cho các thần Ba-anh.
vi.R: Vua sống theo cách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã sống. Vua còn làm những tượng thần bằng kim loại cho các thần Ba-anh.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 이스라엘 왕들의 길들로 걸었고, 바알들을 위해 부어 만든 형상들까지 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 이스라엘 왕들의 길로 걸었다. 그는 또 바알들을 위해 쇠붙이를 부어 만든 형상들을 만들었다.
ko.R: 그는 이스라엘 왕들이 살던 대로 살았다. 그는 심지어 쇠붙이를 녹여 바알들의 우상을 만들었다.

pt.L: E andou nos caminhos dos reis de Israel, e também fez imagens de metal fundido para os baalins.
pt.B: Ele andou nos caminhos dos reis de Israel e também fez imagens de metal fundido para os baalins.
pt.R: Ele viveu como os reis de Israel tinham vivido. Chegou a fazer ídolos de metal para os baalins.

decisions.choice: the ways of the kings of Israel: as 2 Kings 16:3, with the idols added
decisions.reason: Kings says Ahaz walked in "the way" of the kings of Israel; Chronicles has the plural, "the ways". Chronicles then adds what Kings does not say here: that he made images for the Baals. To walk in someone's ways is to live as they did; the northern kings had served Baal since Ahab (1 Kings 16:31-32).

decisions.choice: cast images: idols made of molten metal
decisions.reason: The word names an image cast from melted metal, like the calf Aaron made (Exodus 32:4). The law forbids such images by name (Exodus 34:17; Leviticus 19:4).

decisions.choice: the Baals: Baal in his many local forms
decisions.reason: The plural names the god Baal as he was worshiped at many places and under many titles, as in Judges 2:11 and 2 Chronicles 17:3.

decisions.choice: lived the way; metal idols
decisions.reason: Readable says what "walked in the ways" means, as at 2 Kings 16:3, and calls the cast images "metal idols".

decisions.choice: nos caminhos (L, B), viveu como os reis de Israel tinham vivido (R); imagens de metal fundido (L, B), ídolos de metal (R); os baalins
decisions.reason: The first clause keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 16:3 at each level, with the plural "caminhos" where Chronicles has "ways" (m1), as 22:3 does. The cast images (m2) take the words of 1 Kings 14:9 in Portuguese, and the Baals (m3) are "os baalins", as Judges 2:11.

source.text: וְה֥וּא הִקְטִ֖יר בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֑ם וַיַּבְעֵ֤ר אֶת־בָּנָיו֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made smoke in [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, and he burned his sons in the fire, according to [the] abominations of the nations whom dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And he burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, and he burned his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: He burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom and burned his sons in the fire, following the detestable practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: He burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, and he burned his own sons in the fire as sacrifices. He copied the disgusting practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out of the land ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y quemó incienso en el valle de Ben-hinom, y quemó a sus hijos en el fuego, conforme a las abominaciones de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Quemó incienso en el valle de Ben-hinom y quemó a sus hijos en el fuego, siguiendo las prácticas detestables de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Quemó incienso en el valle de Ben-hinom, y hasta quemó a sus propios hijos en el fuego como sacrificio. Imitó las prácticas repugnantes de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había echado de la tierra para dar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il brûla de l’encens dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, et il brûla ses fils par le feu, selon les abominations des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dépossédées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il brûla de l’encens dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom et brûla ses fils par le feu, selon les pratiques abominables des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il a brûlé de l’encens dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, et il a brûlé ses propres fils dans le feu, en sacrifice. Il a imité les pratiques dégoûtantes des peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés du pays devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Naye akafukiza uvumba katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, akawateketeza wanawe motoni, sawasawa na machukizo ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Alifukiza uvumba katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, akawateketeza wanawe motoni, akifuata desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Alifukiza uvumba katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, akawachoma wanawe mwenyewe motoni kuwa dhabihu. Aliiga desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza kutoka katika nchi mbele ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Vua đốt hương trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, và thiêu các con trai mình trong lửa, theo các điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vua đốt hương trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm và thiêu các con trai mình trong lửa, theo những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vua đốt hương trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, và thiêu chính các con trai mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế. Vua bắt chước những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi ra khỏi xứ trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 분향하고, 그의 아들들을 불에 태웠다. 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 가증한 일들을 따른 것이었다.
ko.B: 그는 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 분향하고, 자기 아들들을 불에 태웠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 역겨운 관습을 따른 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 벤힌놈 골짜기에서 향을 피웠다. 그리고 자기 아들들을 불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들 앞에서 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 끔찍한 풍습을 그대로 따랐다.

pt.L: E ele queimou incenso no vale de Ben-Hinom, e queimou os seus filhos no fogo, conforme as abominações das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Ele queimou incenso no vale de Ben-Hinom e queimou os seus filhos no fogo, seguindo as coisas abomináveis das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos israelitas.
pt.R: Ele queimou incenso no vale de Ben-Hinom e chegou a queimar os seus próprios filhos no fogo como sacrifício. Imitou as coisas abomináveis que faziam as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado da terra para dar lugar aos israelitas.

decisions.choice: burned his sons: where 2 Kings 16:3 has "made his son pass through the fire"
decisions.reason: Chronicles differs from Kings in three ways here. It adds that Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom; it says "his sons", plural, where Kings has "his son"; and it says "he burned" where Kings says "he made pass through". In Hebrew the two verbs are spelled with the same three letters in a different order. Both name the same rite, the offering of children by fire (see the note at 2 Kings 16:3).

decisions.choice: he burned: the Hebrew text followed
alternatives: he made his sons pass through the fire
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "he made pass through" here, as in 2 Kings 16:3, perhaps from the same letters in the other order. The Hebrew text is followed; the meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Ben-hinnom: the valley south of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: "The valley of the son of Hinnom" ran along the south and west of Jerusalem (Joshua 15:8). It became the place where children were burned (2 Kings 23:10; Jeremiah 7:31), and its name, Ge-hinnom, is the source of Gehenna. "His sons" may mean more than one son, or may name the practice in general; Hezekiah, at least, survived (verse 27).

decisions.choice: the abominations of the nations: the practices Deuteronomy forbids
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 18:9-12 forbids the abominations of the nations and names first anyone who makes a son or daughter pass through the fire. Yahweh drove out those nations because of such practices; the king of Judah now takes them up.

decisions.choice: detestable practices / disgusting practices; burned his own sons in the fire as sacrifices
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 16:3 is kept where the Hebrew is the same. Readable adds "as sacrifices" to say what the burning was (m1); it also adds "of the land" to say where the nations were driven from.

decisions.choice: "abominaciones" (L); "prácticas detestables" (B); "prácticas repugnantes" (R); "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 16:3; Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already include women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart, as the Pentateuch note sets it.

decisions.choice: "enfants d'Israël" (Literal), "Israélites" (Balanced, Readable) / "fils d'Israël"
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 16:3, which the rest of the verse follows where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (L); Waisraeli (B, R); no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wana wa Israeli" and "Waisraeli" both name the whole people, men and women, so Swahili needs no gender span here, as in 2 Kings 16:3.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Kings drafts: these Vietnamese words already include men and women, so the language has one wording; recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (Literal, Balanced), "이스라엘 사람들" (Readable), with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" and "사람들" already include women and men, so the setting has nothing to change, as the style guide sets; this holds for the gender spans of verse 10 as well.

decisions.choice: queimou os seus filhos no fogo (L, B); queimar os seus próprios filhos no fogo como sacrifício (R); abominações (L), coisas abomináveis (B, R)
alternatives: fez passar os seus filhos pelo fogo
decisions.reason: Where 2 Kings 16:3 says Ahaz "made his son pass through the fire", Chronicles says "he burned his sons" (m1, m2), and the English follows it, so Literal and Balanced say "queimou os seus filhos no fogo" instead of Kings' "fez ... passar pelo fogo", with the plural. Readable already says "queimar ... no fogo como sacrifício" in 2 Kings 16:3, and keeps it here in the plural. The rest keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 16:3 level by level; the valley is "Ben-Hinom", as 2 Kings 23:10.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 16:3 in Portuguese: "filhos" already includes daughters and "israelitas" names the people, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender setting to offer.
